reviews.text: Grooming and spa day for my girls. Great experience, friendly staff. Will definitely be back. 🐾🐾🐾
This the absolute best groomer you will.wver find.  I can't express how pleased I am with their professional approach to business.  It is a breath of fresh air.  Thank you, Hot Dogs and Cool cats.

This pet and human friendly business is the BEST. The happy atmosphere created there puts me and my dog at ease. I have had Cadence groom my maltese Max for the second time with great results. I highly recommend you give them a try.

The greatest dog grooming Parlor ever!
Alex and her partner are so kind and
knowledgeable about dog breeds. Work is done in the open, and the dogs look amazing when finished. Very reasonable pricing too. Thank you all-
I’m sorry happy to have found you, Mikki loves his new haircut! 💜🐾👍
Such a great grooming experience my dog can be a little nervous around new people but they were patient and gentle with him from the start.

Excellent staff I was in and out in less than 10 minutes.
Nail trim for Amie

I had such a wonderful experience with One Love Pet Parlor! I was looking for a groomer who would be gentle, patient, and truly attentive, and that’s exactly what I found.

They answered the phone right away, took the time to listen to all of my concerns, and their pricing was very fair. My dog is very large and getting older, so I was especially worried about making sure she would be handled with care. The team was incredibly patient, kind, and cautious with her, which gave me so much peace of mind.

I couldn’t be happier with the service and will definitely be coming back. If you’re looking for a groomer who genuinely cares about your pet, I highly recommend One Love Pet Parlor!

I’ve been bringing my 2 doodles here for quite a bit. My one is pretty large and can be a lot to handle, no one has ever complained. They  all do an amazing job. Most recently, I’ve been mainly paired with Cadence and she is absolutely incredible. She spends time and a lot of effort on them and you can tell!! Highly recommend.

This has been the place I normally take my dog to get cleaned up. He's a blue merle pomeranian and needs his cleaning and trimmings. I usually really like how his results are. The last 2 times ive noticed the cutting was uneven. In Oct he had a few red irritated looking spots on his belly and uneven cutting. I didn't really make a big deal out of it.
I had my husband pick him up for me this last time. When I got home, I noticed he was a bit stand-offish and seemed uncomfortable. I picked him up and looked at his belly and saw a really red irritated spot between his private area and belly. I felt so bad and put some ointment on it. Its like he was cut too close to the skin or something. Im not sure if they are just in a hurry to get him done but its really pushed me away from wanting to bring him back.
Finally found the BEST! 🙂🙂🙂🙂🙂
Want a GREAT STAFF TO CARE AND DO A GOOD JOB ! THIS IS THE RIGHT PLACE! Alex is one of the owners, VERY NICE !

I love this groomer. Brittany is my favorite. I have taken three of my long-haired cats to her and she does a phenomenal job and they trust her immensely. Great pricing as well. My kitty in the pic loves the lion cut!
Alex is an amazing human being and excellent groomer. She has been taking care of my dogs for years and they love her.
Love it, dogs love it too 😍
Alex always takes such great care of my pups. She did a wonderful job on my latest foster, Luna. I appreciate her patience and genuine love for our furbabies.
They do amazing so sweet and caring
oh my gosh this place is amazing!! when i first brought my dog there he was so nervous but after the appointment he was jumping and so happy! i appreciate the girls who worked on him!

Madison is great with my dog always looks great after his sessions  great prices for the services rendered. She is really very vested in animals the love she shows is evedident.
I highly recommend this great place the staff is just very good n amazing with animals

Apollo loves coming here. Madison has been grooming him for years and we've never had a bad experience. He always comes home looking super handsome and smelling great. She is attentive to his needs and he always comes home happy
I take my sweet toby here all the time. And he loves the girls so very loving and caring. Treat their customers with  respect and kindness ill keep coming. Back

We have been bringing our dog Milo here for almost 3 years. He can be a handful at times. We have loved our experience here. Maddie is great with him. He looks beautiful when finished. I would highly recommend having your pets groomed here.

I absolutely love this shop everyone is so friendly and kind. And take great care of my boy when he goes in for his bath. Madison and Alex have the best attitudes when I bring him in very welcoming and compassionate feeling. I'm gonna keep coming back again and again

I had such a wonderful experience with this grooming business! The entire staff was friendly, professional, and welcoming from the moment we arrived.

Saydee was absolutely fantastic! She was so kind, patient, and clearly very experienced. She took the time to listen to exactly what I wanted and handled my pet with so much care and attention. When I picked my dog up, she looked amazing—perfectly groomed, clean, and happy.

You can really tell Saydee loves what she does and truly cares about the animals she works with. I highly recommend this place, and I will definitely be coming back. Thank you, Saydee and all the other wonderful girls for such an amazing job!

I’ve been bringing my dogs to Alex for grooming and have had nothing but great experiences. My dogs are very attached to me and can be particular about people, so it’s important that they feel comfortable where they go. The team here is incredibly kind and patient, and you can tell they genuinely care about the animals they work with.

My dog gets excited when it’s time for her appointment, which says a lot about the environment they’ve created. My dogs always come back clean, well groomed, and happy.

Their prices are very fair for the level of care they provide. And they intentionally keep their prices reasonable so dog parents can continue taking care of their pets.

I’m really grateful to have found this place and wouldn’t take my dogs anywhere else. I highly recommend Alex and the team to anyone looking for a groomer who cares about your pets.

I absolutely love coming to your salon. It’s beautiful, the atmosphere feels amazing, and you can truly feel the great vibes the moment you walk in.

Thank you both so much for always taking such great care of my boy. I really appreciate the love and attention you give him. You ladies are the best! 🐾
Marisa and Alex 💜💜💜💜💜

Hell I could've done what she did!!! Very uneven cuts!! Looks like she just hacked at his neck! Now I see why they didn't bring them out before I paid!! Maybe she doesn't have experience with huskies but I was told my babies were very sweet and no problems so why is my little ones (female) belly look like it wasn't washed or brushed!! Very tacky!! Worst grooming yet and for 5 years they were groomed twice a month!! Never again!

We absolutely love One Pet Parlor! Liana sees Saydee and always comes home happy, fresh, and looking amazing. Saydee truly takes pride in what she does, and she works with such great speed and care! 💗

I could not recognize my mini-Goldendoodle after her grooming today. We requested for not too short of a cut and the lady even looked back at notes from prior grooms to ensure they knew exactly what we wanted (we were satisfied with prior cuts). Her hair was shaved way too short and it was uneven on a few areas around her body. I was so shocked by how she turned out. Sadly, she will not look like herself for her first birthday party. Her dress is now way too large and there is barely any hair on her head for her bows. Unfortunately, I cannot take her back. I really liked this place.

Alex and her crew at One Love Pet Parlor are fantastic! We’ve been using them for years and have been very happy with the care our little pup gets. Alex is the only person on the planet who my little Benji will peacefully allow to trim his nails! 😂 We tried several groomers when we first moved here, but none of them were very consistent. We get consistently great service here! We ❤️ One Love!

We do Not recommend to groom your dogs here !  They don’t do a very nice and even job on the cuts and they never smell  good like I ask every time.  We drove a HOUR today to take the dogs here and because we were 16 min late they turned us away.  Well  WE DO HAVE five dogs we have so ITS THEIR loss !!   We found a place close to us and we are happy we don’t have to pay high dollar  ANY LONGER FOR mediocre cuts and grooming.
Great service and our old Terrier mix dog looked great after her visit.
My pug, Frankie, adores Alex and enjoys spaw days at One Love Pet Parlor!!
Kind and professional. Did so well with our two small dogs and they look great! They were so friendly and caring toward the dogs.

These ladies are amazing there love for animals shows and the love for their customers shows as well they always friendly and always go out of their way to make our fur babies comfortable. I also recommend them to anyone who has a hard time with trimming there pups claws...... God bless and I hope that they bless you as much as they blessed us
Kiki loves One Love Pet Parlor! Best more caring treatment. Highly recommend for anyone who loves their pet!! ❤️
One love pet parlor is awesome! I have a high anxiety golden doodle, they took such good care of her. I will definitely be bringing her back.

I have taken my last 5 pets to One Love Pet Parlor.  I have never had a bad experience with them, on the contrary, I only have positive things to say. We have had multiple pets groomed by multiple people at this establishment and not once have we ever had rudeness, miscommunication,  or things done that we didn’t want.  Saydee now takes care of my Mail-Shi and is one of the sweetest people I’ve ever met in my life. If you are looking for an establishment that you can trust to take care of your pets go here!!   No one else will ever take care of my pets again!!  <3

We had one ask. I even wrote it down on a piece of paper and handed it to them. Do not trim our dogs except for around the paws. Just wash them. Our girl dogs came back shaved. Maines gone. Feathers on hind legs gone. They did the complete opposite of what we asked.

Cadence has been grooming my 3 Yorkies  and bernadoodle for well over 5 years. The amount of patience and care that she shows pets and their owners is second to none. She truly loves dogs and delivers a flawless groom everytime. The rest of the staff at this salon are just as amazing as she is. If you want a perfect groom with piece of mind that your pups are being cared for I couldn't recommend a different salon!

Our 70 pound sheepadoodle, Archie, has been going to One Love for about 3 years now and we will never go anywhere else! Saydee takes such good care of him… she is loving, calm, gentle and super knowledgeable about the whole grooming process. She takes time cleaning his ears (not an easy task on doodles!😬) and listens to all my concerns (again, not an easy task🤣) In the morning on his grooming days, when I ask Archie is he wants to go see Saydee, he rushes out the door to get in my car… so so sweet! Alex and all the other groomers are equally loving and knowledgeable. Always easy to get appointments and they’re always right on time. Cannot recommend this salon enough!❤️🐶🐾

Been taking my girl to One Love for over a year now and every time I’m happy with the cut. They all do so well in there, I think about 2-3 of the staff have cut Daisy’s hair and each time she looks adorable! Thank you guys a One Love Pet Parlor  🫶🏾 …
Staff swears at customers in front of owner, can you imagine how your pets are treated?

This has been my favorite grooming spot for my two dogs( King Charles Cavalier) for years. The groomers are so accommodating, do great work. It’s a locally owned business and all around just a lovely place for pets. I can’t say enough nice things about this pet grooming business. I love it here! Thanks One Love Pet Parlor, you’re all fantastic and I really appreciate you taking care of River and Charlie’s haircuts!
Alex has been grooming our girls for years and she and the staff are so amazing!! We are lucky to have her!

This place is an absolute must for anyone who needs a pet groomer. We have had nothing but the best service here and am so grateful for the love and attention our pups get every time. Reasonable prices for the best ‘spa’ treatment for your fur-baby.

I’ve been coming here for a few years now and even though I moved further away I will not take my dogs anywhere else. Literally my favorite grooming spot. Started with just two dogs now I bring in three and they are great with all of them!

The groomers at one love take excellent care of our little guy. They do phenomenal hair cuts every single time and they do it pretty quickly. Our rescue pup looked pretty rough but after going here for a little while he looks nice and cleaned up. Random people even call him "well groomed". They are the place to go, solid every time.
We love one love! Everyone is so sweet and you can tell they love their work!

Took my mini bernedoodle puppy in for his first official haircut and they were absolutely amazing! He looks so cute and it was super affordable as well. I actually took him in for his first trim at petsmart a few weeks ago which was not the best experience and took 3x as long so I’m SO HAPPY I found this place and will keep bringing him back! Thanks again!

OneLove is the absolute best grooming shop in town! We just adore Marisa and her amazing team! I don’t know any other groomer that would come get in our truck and wrestle two big dogs in order to trim their nails! They are seriously the best. So kind, so patient, so understanding!

10/10 experience. I called Alex when no one else would help with my Marley & she gladly took care of him. The service was exceptional, you can tell they really care. Alex and her team are angels. I’m definitely loyal and will be returning. Thank you again❤️

Been coming here for 4 years.  One of my dogs who was previously a very easy going and non aggressive dog is now elderly and does not like to be handled by anyone due to his arthritis and teeth issues.  He snaps at anyone who he thinks is …
Great place to get your dog groomed- or your granddog!
